hand_eye_calibration — CALIB calibrate op

• Data kinds: none → matrix (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hand_eye_calibration(poses_a, poses_b) (to call the implementation directly, import calib; calib.hand_eye_calibration(poses_a, poses_b); from the registry, opscalib.get("hand_eye_calibration"))

Usage

Solves AX=XB from a series of motion pairs and estimates X (4x4) (hand_eye_calibration).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

fail-closed: 姿勢が 3 未満・組の数が合わない・非有限・相対運動の回転軸が 1 方向にしか散っていない(X の回転が決まらない)ときは ValueError。

poses_a/poses_b: 4x4 剛体変換のリスト。隣接運動から相対運動を構成。
